_note: Rover parameters used by the simulation. 'verified': false means the figure is from memory of public NASA descriptions and could not be checked against the official page from the build sandbox (no access to NASA hosts). Check before relying on it. Geometry marked 'measured_from_glb' was measured on the supplied model. Drive-mode figures (drive_force_max_N, drive_power_max_W, base_power_W, battery_wh) are assumptions for a screening model and are all verified:false.

perseverance.name: Mars 2020 Perseverance
perseverance.model_credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech (supplied file 25042_Perseverance.glb, compressed with meshopt and 512 px textures)

wheel_radius_m.origin: measured_from_glb; matches published 52.5 cm wheel diameter

wheelbase_m.value: 2.26 between front and rear axle centres

max_speed_mps.value: 0.042 m/s (about 152 m/h on flat hard ground)

drive_efficiency.origin: assumption for a screening model; not a published figure

drive_force_max_N.value: 1600 N total drive force at zero speed
drive_force_max_N.origin: assumption: about 0.4 of the rover weight on Mars (3.8 kN), chosen so the rover can climb its 30 degree slope limit on firm ground; not a published figure

drive_power_max_W.origin: assumption: order of magnitude of rover mobility power; not a published figure

base_power_W.origin: assumption for avionics, thermal and telecom load while driving; not a published figure

battery_wh.origin: illustrative energy budget for the drive screening, not the real battery capacity

lunar_generic.name: Generic lunar rover (VIPER-class, procedural model)
lunar_generic.model_credit: Procedural Three.js model built for TerraAnalog; not a NASA model

max_speed_mps.origin: approximate public figure for VIPER-class rovers

drive_efficiency.origin: assumption for a screening model; not a published figure

drive_force_max_N.value: 700 N total drive force at zero speed
drive_force_max_N.origin: assumption: about the rover weight on the Moon (697 N); not a published figure

battery_wh.origin: illustrative energy budget for the drive screening, not the real battery capacity
